6. Family Pension.(1) A Government servant/pensioner can receive family pension in addition to own pay or pension, if the spouse dies.
- (2) In the event of such surviving husband/wife also dying, the child/ children of the deceased parents will be granted two family pensions subject to the limits prescribed. - Rule 50 (13), CCS (Pension) Rules.
7. House Rent Allowance.(1) Both are entitled to draw HRA even if they work in the same station and live together but not provided with Government accommodation.
